original_card.question: Can one small, precisely scoped interface lemma be formalized with its actual hypotheses?
methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.
Audit a formal theorem-to-certificate binding independently.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Read the exact hypotheses in the hyperplane-end proof and distinguish Lean theorems from finite supplier assumptions.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: State one missing boundary lemma in full before starting a proof-assistant build.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

actual_scope: Independently bind the three retained noncold HPE pair records and their twelve primitive Lean circuit literals to exact closed-form kernels and the retained Python semantics on all 512 basis columns, in both orientations; verify the three residual factorizations.
scope_change_reason: The assigned card explicitly permits a theorem-to-certificate binding audit. This refines that method to the semantic port for Exact.lean pair1/pair2/pair3, without a new formal arithmetic proof or a full multiplication claim.
bottleneck_link: The selected construction inherits formal interface assumptions. A finite source-to-formal semantic check strengthens one precisely bounded correspondence without changing the paid recursive profile or asserting that other realization and transfer obligations are discharged.
stop_rule: Stop after the complete three-pair finite comparison and meaningful failure controls; report any discrepancy exactly. Do not extend to an unbounded frame-port theorem or a supplier adoption. Reserve the final quarter of the bounded session for verification and handoff.
evidence: RESULT.json: twelve source constructors match the primitive Lean literal circuits; 24 forward/inverse operators each pass 512 columns against independent kernels and source execution; six composite circuits pass all columns; three residual identities pass exact kernel equality; 27 semantic faults have exact coefficient witnesses. Seven focused tests cover additional mathematical and source/receipt/relocation boundaries.
author: commdata2338
ai_assistance: Prepared for commdata2338 (@commdata2338), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, derivation, implementation, verification and writing. No independent human review claimed.

open_questions.question: Can source-to-formal gate semantics be proved for a shared serialized five-gate grammar?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This could reduce the manual semantic-translation trust boundary left by a finite binding audit.
open_questions.first_step: Specify a small formal interpreter for the five gate tags and prove permutation and C-gate correspondence with an explicit common semantics.
open_questions.blocked_by: A formal model of the Python execution semantics or a separately verified common compiler is needed; additional finite examples alone do not establish the general statement.

open_questions.question: Can one current emitted helper be bound end-to-end to these exact operator identities?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An invocation needs actual wrapper placement, scalar rows and labels in addition to a matching pair recipe.
open_questions.first_step: Pin one emitted word using a certified pair; trace both wrapper records and their event positions, then verify the unit helper row and label and hosting hypotheses.
open_questions.blocked_by: The emitted word, complete source closure and the remaining realization hypotheses must be supplied; this package does not newly replay the historical 38-helper runs.

task_card.full_cost_budget_and_observable_improvem: No circuit, recursive-profile or exponent change. Added evidence must be complete exact finite semantic correspondence with independent failure detection; an unchanged successful construction is corroboration.
task_card.success_falsification_and_cap: Every listed matrix column agrees, exact residual identities hold and semantic faults reject. A differing exact coefficient falsifies the claimed binding. Standard-library execution, one process for the audit, 60-minute session budget, no more than eight busy processes or threads and 16 GiB.
